# MerkadAgency

> MerkadAgency is an Austin, Texas agency serving vehicle wrap, paint protection film (PPF), window tint, ceramic coating and auto detailing shops in the United States. It offers portfolio websites, local search marketing and a CRM for inquiries, quotes and follow-up.

Email Camilo Reyna: camilo.reyna@merkadagency.com
Address: 12320 Alameda Trace Cir, Austin, TX 78727

## Marketing, websites and CRM

- [Home](https://merkadagency.com/)
- [Shop marketing](https://merkadagency.com/services/marketing-for-wrap-shops): Portfolio websites, local SEO, Google Business Profile consistency and quote follow-up.
- [MerkadAgency CRM](https://merkadagency.com/services/wrap-shop-crm): Website leads, sales pipeline, quotes and invoices, review requests, email campaigns and click-to-call. Sending from the shop's domain uses its own Resend account.
- [Website development](https://merkadagency.com/services/website-development): Standalone site builds and redesigns.
- [Website brief](https://merkadagency.com/resources/website-brief): Planning guide for website projects.
- [Phantom Wraps & Coatings](https://merkadagency.com/work/phantom-wraps): The website and CRM used at Camilo Reyna's Austin shop.
- [Contact](https://merkadagency.com/contact)
